title: The specified derived compact-support comparison transposes to its termwise projection
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:U\to X$ etale, $c=(i:U\to Z,p:Z\to X)$ a compactification, and $a:f_!\to i_!p_*$ a sheaf comparison [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison]. Define $\delta_H$ on homotopy categories by applying $a$ degreewise and then the counit $p^*p_*\to\mathrm{id}$, with the homotopy composition comparison. Descend $\delta_H$ through the canonical exact factors [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] to $\delta_D:Df_!Dp^*\to Di_!$. Then, for every derived object $K$, $Lp^*(Da_K);\varepsilon_p=\varphi_p(Df_!K);\delta_{D,K}$, where $Da$ is the specified comparison of the cited definition, $Lp^*\dashv Rp_*$ is its specified total-derived adjunction, and $\varphi_p:Lp^*\simeq Dp^*$ is the canonical exact-versus-left-derived comparison. This applies to arbitrary $a$, without an isomorphism assumption.

Localization extensionality gives the transformation identity, hence its component at every K.

theorem compactSupportDerivedComparison_leftDerived_transpose
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (a : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        ((compactSupportDerivedComparison A f c a).app K) ≫
      (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).counit.app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).hom.app
          ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (compactSupportGraphDerivedProjection A f c a).app K
